name: 三択回答を並べた設定表
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Japanese Lighthouse catalog design candidate LH07-0012 三択回答を並べた設定表.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL source image(s) control icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weight, alignment, spacing and fine control anatomy. Our saved FigCraft mock is secondary for Japanese content and overall layout; do not copy its rough substitute icons or omissions. Official Lighthouse white/forest-green/slate design and locked Japanese typography remain binding.
Input images: Image 1: original-source-reference. Image 2: secondary-component-preview. Image 3: approved-style-reference. The final approved bus style image controls only surface/gradient craft, never content or unrelated icons.
Render ONE accessibility three-choice settings table with6 rows, based on original accessibility section and saved complete Japanese mock. Heading 利用しやすさ, Meiryo Bold14px/24px. Row labels top-to-bottom 音声による案内 / 音声の配信 / 入口でのサポート / 段差のない出入口 / 座席でのサポート / 利用しやすい設備. Each row has exactly three horizontally connected equal-width choices 可 / 不可 / 不明 at RIGHT, with shared rounded outer border and subtle internal dividers matching ORIGINAL segment anatomy. Retain the mock's deliberate Japanese text labels instead of source check/cross/question glyphs; do not add those glyphs as new icons. Selected choices must match ORIGINAL and current actual preview: row1不明,row2不明,row3可,row4可,row5不明,row6不明. No 不可 selected. Selected cells forest-green gradient with legible white text; others white with neutral/slate text. Row and option text Meiryo REGULAR400 logical12px/16px, tracking0. Keep labels left, controls aligned in a shared right column, enough gap, compact equal rows with touch-friendly height. Pure-white canvas; one restrained white rounded group with subtle border/shadow, no nested row cards or broad tint. Show complete6rows with no clipping. Original full screen supplies sixth row; target crop ends partly through it. No Less row, offerings, page header, submit actions, phone or extra content. Uniformly enlarged square around1400x1400 with restrained margins.
Official constraints: pure #FFFFFF outer canvas; white rounded cards, fine neutral outlines and soft downward shadows. Primary actions use smooth #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient with legible white glyphs/labels and restrained edge light. Ordinary supporting icons #526173 unless a specifically justified group/state overrides. No broad mint, decorative multicolored icons, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.
Accent decision: Adapt each actual selected answer to forest-green gradient with white Japanese text; keep nonselected neutral. Use same color for yes and unknown because color means selection, not answer quality.
reviewNotes: 全6行と各3択、選択順不明/不明/可/可/不明/不明、日本語25run、白面、原版優先segment枠を生成後目視。accentは選択のみ森緑。要修正:見出し以外のrow/optionがRegularより太い。状態と構成を保持してweightのみ対象修正。厳密font/native/操作/所有者承認なし。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
